methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops delivered by a Norfolk native directly to Hampton Roads communities signals grassroots capacity-building that could distribute deep capability through peer networks rather than platform dependency or institutional concentration.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA creates institutional infrastructure for distributed AI education beyond the Northern Virginia corridor, potentially seeding peer learning networks that build genuine fluency rather than shallow tool adoption.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents concentrated institutional investment in AI leadership development, but its isolation from similar efforts in Southside or Southwest Virginia signals emerging pockets rather than distributed capability across rural regions.

signals.title: How Fairfax County police are using AI — and why opponents are concerned - NBC4 Washington
signals.signal_reading: Fairfax County police deploying AI tools demonstrates how deep technical capability and implementation capacity remains concentrated in well-resourced NoVA jurisdictions while rural Virginia agencies lack comparable resources or expertise.

signals.title: How AI is changing what happens to Hampton Roads' trash - The Suffolk News-Herald
signals.signal_reading: AI-powered waste management in Hampton Roads represents platform-delivered automation that creates operational efficiency without building local technical depth—a classic shallow adoption pattern that relies on vendor solutions rather than indigenous capability.
